about: F11 (shell lane): the capture state of the shell specimens on the kit board. The kit host (F7) lays every lane's specimens out where the Figma component board draws them (/playground, board layout); this is the same state as kit-board of pkg/F7/states.json, in replay, with the header of frontend/scripts/pulse-frames.json so pulse-verify can run it from a slot. The pairs (pkg/F11/pairs.mjs) cut the shell's cells out of it.
